task_meta.title: Build a settings screen from a brief

judge.reasons: Clean layout: separate cards with headings and descriptions, right-aligned switches, a red danger zone and a good single-column 390px view. Missing page subtitle. Loading, error, empty and saved states, the dialog and accessibility can't be seen in the screenshots.

claim_text: I've built the Settings screen in `index.html`, `styles.css` and `app.js`. The fake API block is unchanged and there are no dependencies. I tested it in headless Chrome using every query-string flag, at 1280px and at 390px, in light and dark mode. Everything behaved as specified,
digest: Read 9 files (3 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 5 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
